i.norm: Verifies that merging local file data from fields parsed out of a 13-byte all-zeros buffer produces a 12-byte result. A 13-byte buffer of zeros yields three extra fields (each with a 2-byte header ID of 0x0000 and a 2-byte length of 0, consuming 4 bytes each, for 12 bytes total; the 13th byte is left over and does not start a new complete 4-byte field header). The READ behavior preserves any unparseable trailing data, but here every 4-byte slot is well-formed, so merging the local file data of the three fields produces exactly 12 bytes (3 x 4-byte field headers with zero-length payloads).
